author: Bobby Grayson
description: Leanactors/Explore.lean, namespace Leanactors.Sys: livePids, exploreWith (envMsgs : Pid -> List μ), explore (fixed List μ to every live pid). Signature: explore beh sig check envMsgs s depth env. Steps in search order: run p (live p) ++ signal ++ down ++ timer i ++ env m -> p; labels s!"run {p}", "signal", "down", s!"timer {i}", s!"env {repr m} -> {p}" (requires [Repr μ]). Watchdog's old label was 'env hang -> p'; it is now 'env Leanactors.Gen.Watchdog.Msg.hang -> p' (no recorded witness contains an env step, so outputs are unchanged). Supervisor/Task gained down/timer steps that are never enabled there, so counts are unchanged. Ttl.lean and Lock.lean untouched; their local explore still resolves first (current namespace beats open decls). Suggested README row: Leanactors/Explore.lean | Generic bounded explorer for Sys: Sys.explore / Sys.exploreWith, used by Supervisor, Task, Watchdog. Suggested NOTES edit in section 4: 'Each example file defines checkInv ... and an explore function' -> 'Each example file defines checkInv and calls the shared Sys.explore (Leanactors/Explore.lean)'.
title: Explore.lean API and label caveats for integrator
